name: Yama no Sachi
source: A Yama no Sachi type monster. Yama no Sachi are a type of mountain cat monsters. This Yama no Sachi is very playful and loves to eat. She keeps begging the other monster girls who have pets to feed her their pets and is disappointed when they won't let her eat them. She's very friendly.
translation: A Yama no Sachi type monster. Yama no Sachi are a type of mountain cat monsters. This Yama no Sachi is very playful and loves to eat. She keeps begging the other monster girls who have pets to feed her their pets and is disappointed when they won't let her eat them. She's very friendly.
